arguments.hindsight: The handover needed a secure solid-handle grasp with better wrist separation. The dustpan needed stable support and a flat lip, and the broom's changing angle and slipping grasp required better contact-height verification before sweeping.
arguments.reason: I could not sweep all objects into the dustpan reliably. Both tools are released and both arms are back near their starting poses.

calls.tool_result: Acknowledged give_up.

arguments.hindsight: The handover needed a secure solid-handle grasp with better wrist separation. The dustpan needed stable support and a flat lip, and the broom's changing angle and slipping grasp required better contact-height verification before sweeping.
arguments.reason: I could not sweep all objects into the dustpan reliably. Both tools are released and both arms are back near their starting poses.
